findings.issue: In the test "restores legacy single-page scenes, serializes all pages to JSON, and scopes visual exports via exportScene to the active page" (lines 611-638), spying on `clipboardModule.copyTextToSystemClipboard` does not intercept `exportToClipboard({ type: "json", ... })` because `exportToClipboard` calls `clipboardModule.copyToClipboard`, which in turn invokes `copyTextToSystemClipboard` via a direct intra-module reference inside `clipboard.ts`, causing `copyTextToSystemClipboard` to run unmocked in jsdom and fail with `Error copying to clipboard`.
findings.fix: Spy on `vi.spyOn(clipboardModule, "copyToClipboard").mockResolvedValue()` instead of `copyTextToSystemClipboard`, and assert directly on the first argument passed to `copyToClipboard` (`expect(copySpy.mock.lastCall![0].map((el) => el.id)).toEqual(["rect-p2"])`).
